import React, { useState } from 'react'; import { useNavigate } from 'react-router-dom'; import { useAuth } from '../../hooks/useAuth'; import { toast } from 'react-toastify'; import { FiUser, FiLock, FiShield } from 'react-icons/fi'; // ========================================== // IMPORT LOGO // ========================================== import logo from '../layout/SC ACADEMY new.png'; const AdminLogin = () => { const [username, setUsername] = useState(''); const [password, setPassword] = useState(''); const [loading, setLoading] = useState(false); const { login } = useAuth(); const navigate = useNavigate(); // ========================================== // LOGIN // ========================================== const handleSubmit = async (e) => { e.preventDefault(); setLoading(true); try { const result = await login( username, password ); if (result.success) { toast.success('Login successful!'); navigate('/'); } else { toast.error( result.error || 'Login failed' ); } } catch (error) { console.error( 'Login error:', error ); toast.error( 'An error occurred during login' ); } finally { setLoading(false); } }; return (

setPassword( e.target.value ) } className=" w-full pl-11 pr-4 py-3 border border-blue-200 rounded-xl bg-blue-50 focus:outline-none focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-900/20 focus:border-blue-900 transition-all duration-200 text-blue-900 placeholder:text-blue-300 " placeholder="Enter password" required disabled={loading} autoComplete="current-password" />
